panels.description: Alex wipes dust from a workshop chalkboard where Adrian's equation continues across the surface. Keep the upper board clear.
A balanced water-drop mark is stamped into a brass plate beside an empty recess. Keep the upper plate clear.
Ada finds a hand-drawn mine map marked with three ink ticks and a pipe symbol. Keep the upper map clear.
Beneath a cloth, a single round amber eye pulses in the dark workshop. Keep the upper darkness clear.
